name: windows-v140-multibackend-icloud-and-sync-deletion-parity
title: Windows Parity Handoff (v1.4.0): Simultaneous Multi-Backend Sync, iCloud Drive Folder Sync & Fresh-Install Anti-Resurrection Hardening
description: Mirror macOS/iOS v1.4.0 sync architecture in Windows Rust Core + Tauri + React UI: (1) support simultaneous multi-backend sync profiles (primary + secondary backends with isolated per-backend op cursors, remote asset/folder maps, and safe min-cursor sync_ops pruning) including iCloud Drive for Windows local folder sync; (2) harden deletion tombstones & fresh-install reconciliation so deleted folders, cross-device out-of-order deletes, nil-driveID mounted deletes, and unbound soft-trashed assets are never resurrected, and nested deleted folders are trashed deepest-first.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Keep Windows edits strictly inside windows/. Coordinate with existing GitHub Release v1.4.0 (macOS DMG + iOS IPA already published; replace only the Windows placeholder section when shipping the Windows x64 installer).
